strings.story_mission_spielplatz.title: Mission 01: The Broken Playground
strings.story_mission_spielplatz.opening.caption: At the edge of the Lichtwald lies the children's playground. But something broke, and the children no longer dare to come here. Hannah wants to change that.
strings.story_mission_spielplatz.hannah_listenin: Hannah sits down with the children and listens. Each of them has their own wish for the playground.
strings.story_mission_spielplatz.juan_wishing.ca: Juan sits at the edge of the playground. His wheelchair barely moves over the bumpy ground.
strings.story_mission_spielplatz.lina_wishing.ca: Lina bounces on the spot. She can barely wait to run and play properly again.
strings.story_mission_spielplatz.tobi_wishing.ca: Tobi taps his ball impatiently on the ground. He wants to play right now.
strings.story_mission_spielplatz.oma_linde_wishi: Oma Linde leans against her linden tree and tells stories about the old playground of long ago.
strings.story_mission_spielplatz.first_choice.pr: Oma Linde found 120 light drops – enough to reopen the playground. Where do we start?
strings.story_mission_spielplatz.first_choice.bu: Build a barrier-free path (50 light drops)
Build a new slide (40 light drops)
Set up a football pitch (35 light drops)
Create a quiet corner (30 light drops)
strings.story_mission_spielplatz.second_choice.p: There is still light left. Would you like to build something more?
strings.story_mission_spielplatz.second_choice.f: This is good as it is
strings.story_mission_spielplatz.second_choice.a: Also build the barrier-free path (50 light drops)
Also build the slide (40 light drops)
Also set up the football pitch (35 light drops)
Also create the quiet corner (30 light drops)
strings.story_mission_spielplatz.check_outcome.p: The playground sparkles in the light. How did it turn out?
strings.story_mission_spielplatz.check_outcome.m: Fun, but not everyone is included
strings.story_mission_spielplatz.good.caption: Juan rolls his wheelchair over the new smooth path. All the children laugh and play together. The playground is here for EVERYONE again.
strings.story_mission_spielplatz.middle.caption: The slide and the ball are fun – but Juan sits at the edge again. Somewhere in the forest, it gets a little darker.
strings.story_mission_spielplatz.weak.caption: Nothing new came to be. The children go home, and the playground stays the way it is. Maybe next time …
strings.story_mission_spielplatz.shadow.caption: From the shadows of the trees, a gloomy figure steps out. It whispers softly.
strings.story_mission_spielplatz.licht_rat.capti: The next morning, the Light Council meets. The children have shown that they are there for each other. New adventures are calling.

strings.resource.mut_sterne.name: Courage Stars
strings.resource.freundschaft.name: Friendship
strings.location.spielplatz.name: The Playground
strings.conversation.hannah_listening.listen.tex: I want to know what will make the playground beautiful again. Tell me everything – I'm listening.
strings.conversation.hannah_listening.understood: Thank you! Now I know what each of you wishes for. Let's make it happen together!
strings.conversation.juan_wishes.wish.text: I … I would like to play like the others. But my wheelchair always gets stuck here. A smooth path would be great.
strings.conversation.juan_wishes.thanks.text: Thank you for really listening to me. That means a lot to me.
strings.conversation.juan_wishes.later.text: Juan looks sadly at the ground and says nothing more.
strings.conversation.lina_wishes.wish.text: WE need a slide! The biggest and fastest one in all of Lichtwald! WHOOSH!
strings.conversation.lina_wishes.thanks.text: See? When you listen, you notice how great my idea is!
strings.conversation.lina_wishes.later.text: Lina whistles, annoyed, and hops away.
strings.conversation.tobi_wishes.wish.text: Can we build a football pitch RIGHT NOW? I already have the ball with me! I can't wait!
strings.conversation.tobi_wishes.thanks.text: Really? You listened to me? Okay, then it'll work out!
strings.conversation.tobi_wishes.later.text: Tobi rolls his eyes and kicks a stone.
strings.conversation.oma_linde_wishes.wish.text: A playground is like a tree: it needs roots. A quiet place to arrive – that is what you are missing.
strings.conversation.oma_linde_wishes.thanks.tex: Well listened to, child. That is half the work done.
strings.conversation.oma_linde_wishes.later.text: Oma Linde sighs softly and strokes the bark of her linden tree.
strings.conversation.shadow_whisper.whisper.text: So fast … so loud … so little for the smallest one. When you are in a hurry, I am with you.
strings.conversation.shadow_whisper.fade.text: The figure dissolves. But somewhere in the forest, there is now a little more darkness.
strings.enemy.schatten_der_eile.name: Shadow of Haste
strings.enemy.schatten_der_eile.description: A grey shadow that grows when the children rush and do not listen to each other. It loves haste and forgotten wishes.
strings.encounter.schatten_der_eile.name: The Shadow of Haste
strings.encounter.schatten_der_eile.victory: You stand calm and firm. The Shadow of Haste loses its power and melts away like mist in the morning sun.
strings.encounter.schatten_der_eile.defeat: The shadow grows and whispers: Nothing is lost yet. Perhaps next time …
